c_sensor_response_check.note: direct hybrid_greens kernel applied to the coil's own filaments + the table's sensor list -- NOT through PatchBasis.m_coil, which operator.classify_circuits leaves empty for this (non-MAST) table (see m_coil_shape below).

patch_basis_assembly.operator_gap: operator.classify_circuits hardcodes MAST coil centroids (_PF_COIL_CENTROID) and amc-channel names (_PF_COIL_AMC); this table's circuits are all outside MAST's centroid tolerance and have no amc channels, so every circuit classifies 'inferred_passive' and PatchBasis.m_coil / psi_coil_grid are (*, 0) -- a real, load-bearing, out-of-scope (operator.py) gap for the KNOWN-PF-coil pathway on any non-MAST machine.
